text:
Kira (Partnerships): quick ask — LangChain + an SI want a single marketplace tile that bundles LC connector + our Gateway + an orchestration quickstart. They want a 30-min sandbox and a preflight checklist. Can eng/infra confirm what we need? cc @Devon @Marta

Devon (Eng): list from eng: 1) connector registration API example, 2) webhook callback with HMAC and replay protection, 3) small smoke-test script that posts a job and validates callback. I'll draft the code snippets.

Marta (Infra): infra items: bundle needs `bundle_id` tag, tenant isolation, and a permission manifest for listing. I can template `permission-map.json` and enable a staging tenant within 48h. Also note: billing hooks — marketplace requires an entitlements callback; can someone confirm payload?

Owen (Solutions): partner asked for a sample entitlement webhook. short payload: {tenant_id, bundle_id, entitlement_level}. we should only accept signed requests. I'll add this to smoke-test.

Samir (GTM): marketing needs a 1-paragraph blurb + FAQ: pricing tiers (free sandbox, paid pilot), and a short note about recommended infra (2xA10 demo). Can we get artifacts by EOD Wed?

Devon (Eng): ETA for snippets + smoke-test: EOD Tue. I'll include malformed-signature tests and missing-claims scenarios so partners know fallback behaviors.

Marta (Infra): I'll push the permission-map template and enable the staging tenant by Wed morning. Will also include billing callback spec.

ci-bot: repo-check: partner-quickstarts/interop-smoke CI passed on staging at 2025-03-04T07:12:19Z.

Kira (Partnerships): great — deliverables recap: Devon -> quickstart PR (register curl, HMAC snippet, smoke-test), Marta -> permission-map.json + bundle tagging + billing webhook spec, Owen -> entitlement payload example, Samir -> marketing blurb. I'll schedule sandbox once PRs merge. Thanks all!
